changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: Payment migration blocked: reconcile duplicate active attempts or provider tokens before deployment.

and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT job_assignment_id FROM payments WHERE is_deleted = false AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'VERIFY_PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') GROUP BY job_assignment_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_active_attempts
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT provider_token FROM payments WHERE is_deleted = false AND provider_token IS NOT NULL GROUP BY provider_token HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_provider_tokens

changeSet.comment: Refuse an unsafe rollout, then enforce active-attempt and provider-token invariants.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_payments_one_active_attempt ON payments (job_assignment_id) WHERE is_deleted = false AND status IN ('INITIATED', 'VERIFY_PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW');
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_payments_provider_token ON payments (provider_token) WHERE is_deleted = false AND provider_token IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uk_payments_provider_token; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uk_payments_one_active_attempt;
